meanings.definition: When your body temperature is higher than normal because you are sick.
meanings.example: Mom took my temperature to check if I have a fever.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈量了我的体温，看看我是否发烧。

meanings.definition: When people have “fever” for something, it means everyone is very excited or interested in it.
meanings.example: There was football fever at school when the big game was coming up.
meanings.example_cn: 大赛即将来临，校园里掀起了足球热潮。

meanings.definition: A small number, but more than one.
meanings.example: Few cookies were left on the plate after the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对结束后，盘子里剩下的饼干寥寥无几。

meanings.definition: An open area of land, often used for growing plants or playing sports.
meanings.example: We played soccer in the big green field after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们在大片绿茵场上踢足球。

meanings.definition: A particular area of study, work, or interest.
meanings.example: My aunt works in the field of medicine as a nurse.
meanings.example_cn: 我的姑姑从事医学领域的工作，她是一名护士。

meanings.definition: The last part of something.
meanings.example: The final chapter of the book was the most exciting part.
meanings.example_cn: 这本书的最后一章是最精彩的部分。

meanings.definition: The last game in a contest or tournament.
meanings.example: Our team won the final and took home the trophy.
meanings.example_cn: 我们队赢了决赛，捧回了奖杯。

meanings.definition: To get back something that was lost or hidden.
meanings.example: I can't wait to find hidden eggs during the hunt.
meanings.example_cn: 我迫不及待想在寻宝中找出隐藏的蛋。

meanings.definition: To discover something that was not known before.
meanings.example: In science class, we find out how plants grow by doing experiments.
meanings.example_cn: 在科学课上，我们通过做实验来了解植物如何生长。

meanings.definition: To think or feel a certain way about something.
meanings.definition_cn: 对某事物抱有某种看法或感受，认为。
meanings.example: I find this book really interesting.

meanings.definition: One of the five long parts on each of your hands.
meanings.example: I wore a colourful ring on my finger today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天我手指上戴了一枚彩色的戒指。

meanings.definition: The hot, bright flames that give heat and can burn things.
meanings.example: The campers sat around the fire, roasting marshmallows and telling stories.
meanings.example_cn: 露营者围坐在篝火旁，烤棉花糖、讲故事。

meanings.definition: To set something on fire or make it burn.
meanings.example: Never try to fire dry leaves in the backyard without an adult.
meanings.example_cn: 永远不要在没有大人的情况下在后院点燃干树叶。

meanings.definition: A small insect that can make its body glow in the dark.
meanings.example: I caught a firefly and watched it glow in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 我捉到一只萤火虫，看着它在黑暗中发光。

meanings.definition: Hard and solid, not soft.
meanings.example: This chair is firm, so it's easy to sit up straight.
meanings.example_cn: 这把椅子很结实，坐直很容易。

meanings.definition: A company or business.
meanings.example: My aunt works at a firm that designs tall buildings.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑在一家设计高楼的公司工作。

meanings.definition: Coming before all others in time or order.
meanings.example: I was the first to finish the race at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我是学校里第一个跑完比赛的。

meanings.definition: At the beginning of something or before others.
meanings.example: First, we wash our hands, then we eat dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 首先我们洗手，然后吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: An animal that lives in water and breathes with gills.
meanings.example: We saw a rainbow fish swimming in the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆看到一条彩色鱼在游。

meanings.definition: To catch or try to catch fish
meanings.example: We like to fish at the lake on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 我们周末喜欢去湖边钓鱼。

meanings.definition: Able to bend easily without breaking.
meanings.example: Gymnasts are flexible and can do amazing splits.
meanings.example_cn: 体操运动员身体柔韧，能做惊人的劈叉。

meanings.definition: The flat part of a room that you walk on.
meanings.example: There are building blocks scattered all over the floor.
meanings.example_cn: 地板上散落着许多积木。

meanings.definition: The colourful part of a plant that makes seeds or fruit.
meanings.example: We picked a bright yellow flower from the garden for the vase.
meanings.example_cn: 我们为花瓶从花园里摘了一朵明亮的黄花儿。

meanings.definition: To start producing flowers.
meanings.example: The cherry trees will flower in spring and look beautiful.
meanings.example_cn: 樱花树会在春天开花，看起来很漂亮。

meanings.definition: An illness like a cold, with fever, aches, and cough.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school when I had the flu.
meanings.example_cn: 我得了流感，就没去上学。

meanings.definition: To move through the air, like a bird or an aeroplane.
meanings.example: The colourful kite can fly high in the sky.
meanings.example_cn: 那只彩色风筝能在天空中飞得很高。

meanings.definition: A small insect with wings that can buzz around and often lands on food or people.
meanings.example: A fly buzzed around the kitchen looking for crumbs.

meanings.definition: To go behind someone.
meanings.example: The puppy will follow you wherever you go.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗会跟着你走到任何地方。

meanings.definition: To understand what someone is saying or doing.
meanings.example: I can follow the instructions if you read them slowly.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你慢慢读，我能听懂这些说明。

meanings.definition: To do what someone tells you or copy their actions.
meanings.definition_cn: 听从某人的话或模仿他们的做法。
meanings.example: Please follow the teacher’s instructions.

meanings.definition: The part at the end of your leg that you stand or walk on.
meanings.example: I hurt my foot while running, but it’s better now.
meanings.example_cn: 我跑步时伤了脚，但现在好多了。

meanings.definition: Shows why or for what reason something is done.
meanings.example: I made a card for my friend's birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我为朋友的生日做了一张卡片。

meanings.definition: During a certain length of time.
meanings.example: We waited for two hours to see the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 我们等了两个小时看游行。

meanings.definition: Power or strength used to move or change something.
meanings.example: The force of the wind knocked over the garden fence.
meanings.example_cn: 风力把花园的栅栏吹倒了。

meanings.definition: To make someone do something even if they don’t want to.
meanings.example: Sometimes I have to force myself to finish my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 有时我得强迫自己完成作业。

meanings.definition: A large area filled with many trees and plants.
meanings.example: We spotted a deer in the quiet forest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在安静的森林里看到了一头鹿。

meanings.definition: To stop being angry with someone who has done something wrong.
meanings.example: It’s important to forgive your friends when they say sorry.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友道歉时原谅他们很重要。

meanings.definition: A tool with points, used for eating food.
meanings.example: I used a fork to eat my salad at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭时我用叉子吃沙拉。

meanings.definition: To start or set up something, like a business or a city.
meanings.example: In 1919, people worked together to found the school where we study today.
meanings.example_cn: 1919 年，人们齐心协力创办了我们如今就读的这所学校。

meanings.definition: The sixth day of the week.
meanings.example: Friday is my favourite day because it’s the start of the weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 星期五是我最喜欢的一天，因为它是周末的开始。

meanings.definition: Someone you like and spend time with.
meanings.example: My best friend and I built a giant sandcastle together.
meanings.example_cn: 我最好的朋友和我一起堆了一座巨大的沙堡。

meanings.definition: Kind and easy to get along with.
meanings.example: The friendly cat rubbed against my legs and purred.
meanings.example_cn: 那只友好的猫蹭着我的腿，发出咕噜声。

meanings.definition: A small, green animal that jumps and lives near water.
meanings.example: A green frog jumped off the lily pad into the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 一只绿青蛙从睡莲叶上跳进了池塘。

meanings.definition: Shows where someone or something started or came from.
meanings.example: We walked from our house to the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从家走到操场。

meanings.definition: When you use “from” with time, it tells you when something begins.
meanings.example: The school play will run from 6 o’clock to 8 o’clock.
meanings.example_cn: 这场校园戏剧的演出时间为六点到八点。

meanings.definition: To make your face look unhappy or angry by bringing your eyebrows together.
meanings.example: Anna began to frown when she saw her broken toy.
meanings.example_cn: 安娜看到她坏掉的玩具时，开始皱起眉头。

meanings.definition: The look on your face when you’re upset, confused, or not happy, and your mouth turns down and your eyebrows get close together.
meanings.example: A big frown appeared on Ben’s face when he lost his favourite pencil.
meanings.example_cn: 本弄丢了他最心爱的铅笔，脸上露出浓浓的愁容。

meanings.definition: The sweet part of a plant that you can eat, like an apple or banana.
meanings.example: Fruit salad is a sweet and healthy snack.
meanings.example_cn: 水果沙拉是香甜健康的零食。

meanings.definition: Holding as much as possible, so nothing more can fit.
meanings.example: The basket was full of shiny apples from the orchard.
meanings.example_cn: 篮子里装满了果园里闪亮的苹果。

meanings.definition: You have eaten enough and can’t eat any more food.
meanings.example: After eating a big lunch, I was so full I couldn’t eat dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 吃完丰盛的午饭后，我太饱了，吃不下甜点。

meanings.definition: An activity with rules that people play for fun or competition.
meanings.example: Our favourite game is hide-and-seek in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们最喜欢的游戏是在后院玩捉迷藏。

meanings.definition: A piece of ground where flowers, vegetables, or plants are grown.
meanings.example: Grandma’s garden is full of colourful flowers and butterflies.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶的花园长满了彩色花朵和蝴蝶。

meanings.definition: To work in a garden, growing and caring for plants
meanings.example: Grandma loves to garden and grows tomatoes every summer.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶喜欢打理菜园，每年夏天都种西红柿。

meanings.definition: Happy to give or share with others.
meanings.example: She is generous and always shares her snacks with others.
meanings.example_cn: 她很大方，总是和别人分享她的零食。

meanings.definition: Kind and careful not to hurt anyone or anything.
meanings.example: He was gentle with the tiny kitten.
meanings.example_cn: 他对那只小猫很温柔。

meanings.definition: Soft or light in the way you act or touch.
meanings.example: The gentle breeze felt nice on my face.
meanings.example_cn: 和煦的微风拂过我的脸，很舒服。

meanings.definition: To receive, obtain, or come to have something.
meanings.example: I hope to get a new book for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望生日时能得到一本新书。

meanings.definition: To become a certain way or start to be something.
meanings.example: If you stay outside too long, you'll get cold.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你在外面待太久，会着凉的。

meanings.definition: Something given to someone, often for a special reason.
meanings.example: I gave my friend a gift for her birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我送了一份礼物给朋友过生日。

meanings.definition: A natural talent or special ability someone has.
meanings.example: He has a gift for playing the violin beautifully.
meanings.example_cn: 他有演奏小提琴的天赋，拉得非常好听。

meanings.definition: A tall animal with a very long neck and spots, found in Africa.
meanings.example: The giraffe’s long neck helps it reach tall trees.
meanings.example_cn: 长颈鹿的长脖子帮它够到高处的树叶。

meanings.definition: A female child or young person.
meanings.example: The girl with the braids won the art contest.
meanings.example_cn: 那个扎辫子的女孩赢得了艺术比赛。

meanings.definition: To hand something to someone else.
meanings.example: Please give this note to your teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 请把这张纸条交给你的老师。

meanings.definition: To provide something so another person can have it.
meanings.example: The library will give us new books every month.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆每个月都会给我们新书。

meanings.definition: Clothing you wear on your hand to keep it warm or safe.
meanings.example: Dad wears a glove when he works in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸在花园干活时戴着手套。

meanings.definition: To move from one place to another.
meanings.example: We will go to the museum after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们要去博物馆。

meanings.definition: To leave a place or move away.
meanings.example: It's getting late, so we should go now.
meanings.example_cn: 天晚了，我们现在该走了。

meanings.definition: Something you try to achieve.
meanings.example: My goal is to read ten books this summer.
meanings.example_cn: 我的目标是这个夏天读十本书。

meanings.definition: The place where you score points in a game.
meanings.example: She kicked the ball straight into the goal and scored a point.
meanings.example_cn: 她一脚把球踢进球门，得了一分。

meanings.definition: A shiny, yellow metal that is valuable.
meanings.example: The crown in the museum was made of shiny gold.
meanings.example_cn: 博物馆里的王冠是用闪亮的黄金做的。

meanings.definition: Made from the valuable yellow metal called gold.
meanings.example: Grandma gave me a gold necklace for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶送了我一条金项链作为生日礼物。

meanings.definition: Not here anymore because someone or something has left.
meanings.example: My ice cream was gone before I even finished my sandwich.
meanings.example_cn: 我还没吃完三明治，我的冰淇淋就已经没了。

meanings.definition: Of high quality.
meanings.example: She got a good grade on her spelling test.
meanings.example_cn: 她拼写测验得了好成绩。

meanings.definition: Being kind, caring, or helpful.
meanings.example: It was good of you to help your friend clean up.
meanings.example_cn: 你帮助朋友打扫卫生真是太好了。

meanings.definition: A word you say when you leave someone.
meanings.example: I waved goodbye to my friends after the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对结束后我向朋友们挥手告别。

meanings.definition: The group of people who make rules and run a country.
meanings.example: The government helps keep our city clean and safe.
meanings.example_cn: 政府帮助我们的城市保持清洁和安全。

meanings.definition: To take something quickly and suddenly.
meanings.example: Please grab your backpack before we leave the house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们出门前请拿起你的背包。

meanings.definition: A sudden, rough snatch or attempt to seize
meanings.example: With one quick grab, he caught the bouncing ball.
meanings.example_cn: 他迅速一抓，接住了弹起来的球。

meanings.definition: A mark or score that shows how well you did at something.
meanings.example: I got a good grade on my maths test.
meanings.example_cn: 我数学考试得了好成绩。

meanings.definition: To give a score or mark for how well something was done.
meanings.example: The teacher will grade our science projects this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会在周末给我们科学项目打分。

meanings.definition: A small, round, sweet fruit that grows in bunches.
meanings.example: I packed a handful of grapes in my lunchbox.
meanings.example_cn: 我在饭盒里装了一把葡萄。

meanings.definition: A large, round, citrus fruit that is yellow or pink inside.
meanings.example: Grapefruit tastes sour but is very healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 西柚尝起来很酸，但很健康。

meanings.definition: The green plants that cover the ground in fields and gardens.
meanings.example: We lay on the soft grass to watch the clouds.
meanings.example_cn: 我们躺在柔软的草地上看云。

meanings.definition: A green insect that jumps and makes a chirping sound.
meanings.example: The grasshopper leaped into the tall grass.
meanings.example_cn: 蚱蜢跳进了高高的草丛里。

meanings.definition: Feeling thankful for something someone has done.
meanings.example: I am grateful for my family and friends every day.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天都很感激我的家人和朋友。

meanings.definition: Something is excellent, wonderful, or much better than usual.
meanings.definition_cn: 极好的；远超平常水平的
meanings.example: We had a great time at the amusement park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在游乐园玩得很开心。

meanings.definition: Something or someone has a lot of importance, power, or influence.
meanings.example: It’s a great honour to carry the school flag.
meanings.example_cn: 举校旗是一种莫大的荣誉。

meanings.definition: Much bigger, higher, or more than usual.
meanings.definition_cn: 比平时更大、更高或更多，巨大的。
meanings.example: The elephant is a great animal because it is so big.

meanings.definition: The colour of grass or leaves.
meanings.example: The grass in the park is bright green after it rains.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨后公园里的草是鲜绿色的。

meanings.definition: To say hello to someone.
meanings.example: We greet our teacher every morning with a smile.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每天早上面带微笑向老师问好。

meanings.definition: The colour between black and white, like clouds.
meanings.example: The sky turned grey before it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 开始下雨前天空变成了灰色。

meanings.definition: To smile with your mouth wide open.
meanings.example: She couldn't help but grin when she saw her birthday cake.
meanings.example_cn: 看到生日蛋糕时，她忍不住咧嘴笑了。

meanings.definition: A wide, happy smile that shows your teeth.
meanings.example: A big grin spread across his face after he won the race.
meanings.example_cn: 赢得比赛后，他脸上漾开一个大大的笑容。

meanings.definition: A number of people or things that are together.
meanings.example: Our group finished the project before the deadline.
meanings.example_cn: 我们小组在截止日期前完成了项目。

meanings.definition: To gather things or people together in one place.
meanings.example: Let’s group the blocks by colour.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们按颜色把积木分组。

meanings.definition: A person who shows others the way.
meanings.example: Our guide pointed out interesting animals during the nature walk.
meanings.example_cn: 向导在大自然漫步中指出有趣的动物。

meanings.definition: To show or lead the way for someone.
meanings.example: Let me guide you through the steps of this science experiment.
meanings.example_cn: 让我带你一步步完成这个科学实验。

meanings.definition: Another word for a man or boy.
meanings.example: The guy who lives next door has a cool bicycle.
meanings.example_cn: 住在隔壁的那个人有一辆很酷的自行车。

meanings.definition: A room or building with equipment for exercise or sports.
meanings.example: We have gym class every Wednesday at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学校每周三都有体育课。

meanings.definition: The thin strands that grow on your head and sometimes on your body.
meanings.example: She braided her long hair before going to school.
meanings.example_cn: 上学前她把长头发编成了辫子。

meanings.definition: One of two equal parts when something is divided into two.
meanings.example: I ate half of my sandwich and saved the rest for later.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了半个三明治，剩下的留着晚点吃。

meanings.definition: Being one of the two equal parts of something.
meanings.example: The pizza was half cheese and half pepperoni.
meanings.example_cn: 这个披萨一半是奶酪，一半是意大利辣香肠。

meanings.definition: The part at the end of your arm that you use to hold things, with fingers and a thumb.
meanings.example: She wore a bracelet on her left hand.
meanings.example_cn: 她左手戴着一条手链。

meanings.definition: To give something to someone by passing it to them.
meanings.example: Please hand this note to your teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 请把这张纸条交给你的老师。

meanings.definition: To take place or occur when something comes about.
meanings.example: What will happen if it rains during the picnic?
meanings.example_cn: 野餐时下雨了会发生什么？

meanings.definition: Feeling pleased, glad, or joyful.
meanings.example: I felt happy when my friends came over to play.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友们过来玩时我感到很开心。

meanings.definition: Not soft, so it is firm or difficult to press.
meanings.example: This chair feels hard, but it’s sturdy.
meanings.example_cn: 这把椅子摸起来很硬，但很结实。

meanings.definition: Needing a lot of effort, not easy to do.
meanings.example: That was a hard puzzle, but you solved it!
meanings.example_cn: 那是个很难的拼图，但你解出来了！

meanings.definition: Done with a lot of effort or strength, not easy.
meanings.definition_cn: 用很大力气或努力地去做，不轻松。
meanings.example: She worked hard to finish her project on time.

meanings.definition: Always trying your best and never giving up because you work a lot.
meanings.example: The hardworking ant carried a crumb back to its nest.
meanings.example_cn: 勤劳的蚂蚁衔着一块面包屑回巢。

meanings.definition: Very mean, rough, or not gentle.
meanings.example: The harsh wind made it hard to walk outside.
meanings.example_cn: 刺骨的风让人很难在外面行走。

meanings.definition: The form of “have” used with he, she, or it.
meanings.definition_cn: 有（have的第三人称单数形式）
meanings.example: She has a beautiful new backpack for school.
meanings.example_cn: 她有一个漂亮的新书包上学用。

meanings.definition: Something you wear on your head to keep warm or for style.
meanings.example: I wore a funny hat to the costume party.
meanings.example_cn: 我戴着一顶有趣的帽子参加化装派对。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about a boy or a man.
meanings.example: He wore his new shoes to school today.
meanings.example_cn: 他今天穿着新鞋去上学。

meanings.definition: The top part of your body with your face, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
meanings.example: He wore a red cap on his head in the sun.
meanings.example_cn: 他头上戴着一顶红帽子遮太阳。

meanings.definition: The top or highest part of something.
meanings.example: The title is written at the head of the page.
meanings.example_cn: 标题写在页面的顶部。

meanings.definition: To go in a certain direction.
meanings.example: We will head to the park after lunch.

meanings.definition: A pain inside your head.
meanings.example: I got a headache after reading in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 在黑暗里看书后我头疼了。

meanings.definition: The condition of your body and mind being well, not sick.
meanings.example: Eating fruit and veggies is good for your health.
meanings.example_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜对你的健康有益。

meanings.definition: To use your ears to notice sounds.
meanings.example: Did you hear the birds singing outside the window?
meanings.example_cn: 你听见窗外鸟儿在唱歌吗？

meanings.definition: To learn about something by being told or hearing it.
meanings.example: I hear there's going to be a school play next month.
meanings.example_cn: 我听说下个月学校要演话剧。

meanings.definition: The organ in your chest that pumps blood all around your body.
meanings.example: Your heart beats faster when you run really quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 你跑得很快时，心脏会跳得更快。

meanings.definition: The centre of your feelings or emotions.
meanings.example: She has a kind heart and always helps her friends.
meanings.example_cn: 她心地善良，总是帮助朋友。

meanings.definition: A shape with two curves at the top and a point at the bottom, used to show love or care.
meanings.definition_cn: 一种顶部有两个圆弧、底部有一个尖角的形状，用来表示爱或关心。
meanings.example: She drew a heart on her card to show love.

meanings.definition: Hard to lift because it weighs a lot.
meanings.example: The box was too heavy for me to lift alone.
meanings.example_cn: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

meanings.definition: A word you say to greet someone.
meanings.example: I always say hello to my neighbours when I see them.
meanings.example_cn: 我看到邻居时总是向他们问好。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about a girl or woman as the object in a sentence.
meanings.example: I saw her at the library reading a big book.
meanings.example_cn: 我在图书馆看到她在读一本大书。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a girl or woman.
meanings.example: Her backpack is decorated with bright stickers.
meanings.example_cn: 她的背包上贴满了明亮的贴纸。

meanings.definition: A plant used in cooking to give food flavour.
meanings.example: We planted a basil herb in our kitchen garden.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在厨房小菜园里种了罗勒香草。

meanings.definition: In this place.
meanings.example: Come here and look at this funny photo!
meanings.example_cn: 过来看看这张有趣的照片！

meanings.definition: At this point.
meanings.example: Here is where the story gets exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 这里就是故事变得精彩的地方。

meanings.definition: Used to show that the girl or woman is doing something to or for herself.
meanings.example: She made herself a peanut butter sandwich.
meanings.example_cn: 她给自己做了一个花生酱三明治。

meanings.definition: Tall or far above the ground.
meanings.example: The flag is flying high on the pole.
meanings.example_cn: 旗子高高地飘在旗杆上。

meanings.definition: A great amount or level.
meanings.example: He scored a high number of points in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 他在游戏中得了很多分。

meanings.definition: A piece of land that rises higher than the land around it, but is smaller than a mountain.
meanings.example: We rolled down the grassy hill and laughed a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从长满草的山坡上滚下来，笑得很开心。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about a boy or man as the object in a sentence.
meanings.example: Give him the blue cup because it’s his favourite.
meanings.example_cn: 把蓝色的杯子给他，因为那是他最喜欢的。

meanings.definition: Used to show that the boy or man is doing something to or for himself.
meanings.example: He taught himself to play the guitar.
meanings.example_cn: 他自学了弹吉他。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a boy or man.
meanings.example: Max forgot his blue backpack at school yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天马克把他的蓝色背包忘在学校了。

meanings.definition: Things that happened in the past.
meanings.example: We learned about ancient Egypt in history class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在历史课上学了古埃及。

meanings.definition: To touch someone or something quickly and with force.
meanings.example: Don’t hit the drum too loudly during music class.
meanings.example_cn: 音乐课上别把鼓敲得太响。

meanings.definition: To cause harm, trouble, or difficulty for someone or something.
meanings.example: The storm hit the town hard and many homes lost power.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨猛烈袭击了小镇，许多家庭断电了。

meanings.definition: To accomplish a goal or reach a target.
meanings.example: He hit his goal and finished the puzzle all by himself.

meanings.definition: To keep something in your hand or arms.
meanings.example: Please hold my hand when we cross the street.
meanings.example_cn: 过马路时请牵着我的手。

meanings.definition: A firm grip or grasp on something
meanings.example: The gymnast kept a strong hold on the bar.
meanings.example_cn: 体操运动员紧紧握住单杠。

meanings.definition: The place where you live and feel safe.
meanings.example: I feel safe and happy at home with my family.
meanings.example_cn: 在家和家人在一起，我感到安全又快乐。

meanings.definition: To or at your house, or the place you live.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school because I wasn't feeling well.
meanings.example_cn: 因为我感觉不舒服，就没去上学。

meanings.definition: Schoolwork that you do at home.
meanings.example: I finished my homework before dinner so I could relax.
meanings.example_cn: 我在晚饭前完成了作业，这样就能放松了。

meanings.definition: Always telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
meanings.example: It’s always best to be honest and tell the truth.
meanings.example_cn: 诚实、说真话永远是最好的。

meanings.definition: The thick, sweet food made by bees.
meanings.example: Bees make sweet honey from flowers.
meanings.example_cn: 蜜蜂用花朵酿出甜甜的蜂蜜。

meanings.definition: To jump into the air, often using one foot.
meanings.example: The bunny likes to hop around the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 小兔子喜欢在花园里蹦蹦跳跳。

meanings.definition: A short jump, especially on one foot
meanings.example: The bunny made a big hop across the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 小兔子在草地上重重一跳。

meanings.definition: To want something good to happen.
meanings.example: I hope we can visit the zoo this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望这个周末我们能去动物园。

meanings.definition: A wish that something good will happen.
meanings.example: Her biggest hope is to become a great artist.
meanings.example_cn: 她最大的愿望是成为一名伟大的艺术家。

meanings.definition: Feeling sure or believing that something good will happen.
meanings.definition_cn: 抱有希望的；满怀希望的
meanings.example: I am hopeful that the sun will come out tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望明天太阳会出来。

meanings.definition: A large animal with four legs that people can ride.
meanings.example: The horse galloped across the open field.
meanings.example_cn: 马奔驰过开阔的田野。

meanings.definition: A place where doctors and nurses help people who are sick or hurt.
meanings.example: My sister was born in the hospital downtown.
meanings.example_cn: 我妹妹在市中心的一家医院出生。

meanings.definition: Having a very high temperature, so it feels warm when you touch it.
meanings.example: Be careful, the soup is hot!
meanings.example_cn: 小心，汤很烫！

meanings.definition: A length of time that is sixty minutes long.
meanings.example: It takes about an hour to drive to grandma’s house.
meanings.example_cn: 开车去奶奶家大约要一个小时。

meanings.definition: A building where people live.
meanings.example: Our house has a bright red door and a big yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的房子有一扇鲜红色的门和一个大院子。

meanings.definition: To provide someone with a place to live.
meanings.example: The animal shelter will house the lost puppy until someone adopts it.
meanings.example_cn: 动物收容所会收留这只走失的小狗，直到有人领养它。

meanings.definition: To contain or store something.
meanings.example: The barn can house many animals during the winter.

meanings.definition: A word used to show something different, like “but.”
meanings.example: I wanted to play outside; however, it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 我想出去玩；然而，开始下雨了。

meanings.definition: A number that is equal to ten groups of ten (100).
meanings.example: There are one hundred students in the whole primary 1.
meanings.example_cn: 整个一年级一共有一百名学生。

meanings.definition: To do something quickly because there isn’t much time.
meanings.example: Hurry or we'll miss the beginning of the movie!
meanings.example_cn: 快一点，否则我们会错过电影的开头！

meanings.definition: Fast movement because there isn’t much time.
meanings.example: In all the hurry to get ready, I forgot my lunchbox.
meanings.example_cn: 在匆忙准备中，我忘带了饭盒。

meanings.definition: A wild animal that looks like a dog and makes a laughing sound.
meanings.example: The hyena laughed as it played with its friends.
meanings.example_cn: 鬣狗和朋友们玩耍时发出笑声。

meanings.definition: The word you use when talking about yourself.
meanings.example: I really enjoy reading adventure stories at night.
meanings.example_cn: 我真的很喜欢晚上读冒险故事。

meanings.definition: A thought, plan, or suggestion you think of.
meanings.example: I have an idea for our art project.
meanings.example_cn: 我对我们的艺术项目有个想法。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about something that might happen, depending on another thing.
meanings.example: If you finish your homework, we can play outside.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你完成作业，我们就可以出去玩。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about what will happen or might happen, depending on something else.
meanings.example: I don't know if it will rain tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。

meanings.definition: A picture or drawing of something.
meanings.example: I drew an image of a castle for art class.
meanings.example_cn: 我为美术课画了一座城堡的图像。

meanings.definition: Not wanting to wait and getting annoyed when things take too long.
meanings.example: I felt impatient waiting for my turn on the swing.
meanings.example_cn: 排队等荡秋千的时候，我等得不耐烦了。

meanings.definition: Something that matters a lot or needs attention.
meanings.example: It’s important to be kind to others every day.
meanings.example_cn: 每天善待他人很重要。

meanings.definition: Inside a space or place.
meanings.example: The puppy is sleeping in the soft basket.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗正睡在柔软的篮子里。

meanings.definition: Happening during a certain period of time.
meanings.example: We go swimming in the summer when it's hot.
meanings.example_cn: 夏天很热时我们去游泳。

meanings.definition: Harm or damage to your body.
meanings.example: I got a small injury on my knee while playing soccer.
meanings.example_cn: 踢足球时我的膝盖受了点小伤。

meanings.definition: To strongly say that something must happen or is true.
meanings.example: I insist that you try a piece of this delicious cake.
meanings.example_cn: 我坚持让你尝一块这块美味的蛋糕。

meanings.definition: Something you plan or mean to do.
meanings.example: My intention was to finish my project early.
meanings.example_cn: 我的打算是早点完成项目。

meanings.definition: Moving inside something.
meanings.example: The frog jumped into the cool, clear pond.
meanings.example_cn: 青蛙跳进了清凉清澈的池塘。

meanings.definition: Becoming part of it.
meanings.example: When I mixed blue and yellow paint, they turned into green.
meanings.example_cn: 我把蓝色和黄色颜料混合后，它们变成了绿色。

meanings.definition: To ask someone to come to your home or event.
meanings.example: I want to invite my friends to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我想邀请我的朋友来参加我的生日派对。

meanings.definition: A request asking someone to come to an event.
meanings.example: I got an invite to Sam's birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我收到了山姆生日聚会的邀请。

meanings.definition: The form of “be” used with he, she, or it.
meanings.example: My favourite toy is a bright red car.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的玩具是一辆鲜红色的汽车。

meanings.definition: Land that is completely surrounded by water.
meanings.example: We visited a small island during our summer vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 暑假我们参观了一个小岛。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about a thing, animal, or idea already known.
meanings.example: I found a little turtle, and it was hiding under a leaf.
meanings.example_cn: 我找到一只小乌龟，它躲在一片叶子下面。

meanings.definition: Used when talking about something already mentioned or known.
meanings.example: I finished my project, and it was a lot of work.
meanings.example_cn: 我完成了我的项目，它花了很多功夫。

meanings.definition: Belonging to a thing or animal.
meanings.example: The turtle hid inside its hard shell.
meanings.example_cn: 乌龟躲在它坚硬的壳里。

meanings.definition: Used to show the thing or animal is doing something to or for itself.
meanings.example: The cat cleaned itself after eating lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 猫吃完午饭后给自己清洗了一番。

meanings.definition: A short coat you wear over your clothes to keep warm.
meanings.example: Don’t forget your jacket; it’s cold outside!
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了你的夹克，外面很冷！

meanings.definition: A sweet, thick food made from fruit and sugar, often spread on bread.
meanings.example: I spread sweet strawberry jam on my toast.
meanings.example_cn: 我在吐司上抹了甜甜的草莓果酱。

meanings.definition: To squeeze or pack tightly into a space.
meanings.example: We had to jam all our toys into the toy chest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们只好把所有玩具硬塞进玩具箱。

meanings.definition: To become stuck and not move.
meanings.example: The lid on the jar jammed and wouldn’t open.

meanings.definition: The first month of the year.
meanings.example: January is the first month of the year.
meanings.example_cn: 一月是一年中的第一个月。

meanings.definition: Wanting what someone else has and feeling unhappy because of it.
meanings.example: I felt jealous when my friend got a new bike.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友得到一辆新自行车时我很嫉妒。

meanings.definition: A sweet, wobbly dessert made from fruit juice and sugar.
meanings.example: The wobbly red jelly on my plate looked like it might bounce right off!
meanings.example_cn: 我盘子里那摇晃的红色果冻，看起来好像马上就要弹出去了！

meanings.definition: A soft, sea animal with a round body and long, thin parts that float in water.
meanings.example: The jellyfish glowed under the blue lights at the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 水母在水族馆的蓝色灯光下发光。

meanings.definition: Work that people do to earn money.
meanings.example: Dad’s job is to fix cars at the garage.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸的工作是在修车厂修理汽车。

meanings.definition: A task that people do to help others.
meanings.example: The crossing guard’s job is to help kids cross the street safely.
meanings.example_cn: 交通协管员的工作是帮助孩子们安全过马路。

meanings.definition: Something said or done to make people laugh.
meanings.example: He told a funny joke that made everyone laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，让大家都笑了。

meanings.definition: To say something funny.
meanings.example: He likes to joke and always makes us laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他喜欢开玩笑，总能把我们逗笑。

meanings.definition: The seventh month of the year.
meanings.example: July is usually hot and perfect for swimming.
meanings.example_cn: 七月通常很热，最适合游泳。

meanings.definition: To push yourself off the ground into the air using your legs.
meanings.example: I can jump higher than I could last year.
meanings.example_cn: 我比去年跳得更高了。

meanings.definition: An act of jumping.
meanings.example: She made a long jump over the puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 她纵身一跃，跳过了水坑。

meanings.definition: A sudden increase or rise.
meanings.example: There was a big jump in the number of students this year.

meanings.definition: The sixth month of the year.
meanings.example: School ends in June and summer vacation begins.
meanings.example_cn: 学校六月结束，暑假开始。

meanings.definition: Only or no more than something.
meanings.example: I have just one piece of candy left.
meanings.example_cn: 我只剩一块糖果了。

meanings.definition: Happened a very short time ago, very recently.
meanings.example: I just finished my homework a minute ago.
meanings.example_cn: 我一分钟前刚做完作业。

meanings.definition: Exactly right or at the right time, no more and no less.
meanings.definition_cn: 恰好正确或正好及时，不多不少。
meanings.example: You arrived just in time for the movie to start.

meanings.definition: Very eager and wanting to do something a lot.
meanings.example: She is keen to learn new words every day.
meanings.example_cn: 她热切地想每天学新单词。

meanings.definition: To hit something using your foot.
meanings.example: I can kick the soccer ball into the goal.
meanings.example_cn: 我能把足球踢进球门。

meanings.definition: A blow or hit with the foot
meanings.example: His kick sent the soccer ball into the goal.
meanings.example_cn: 他一脚把足球踢进了球门。

meanings.definition: A child or young person.
meanings.example: Every kid in class brought a snack for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 班里每个孩子都带了零食来参加派对。

meanings.definition: To say something is not true as a joke.
meanings.example: I was just kidding when I said there was a monster under the bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我说床底下有怪物，我只是在开玩笑。

meanings.definition: A type or sort of thing in a group.
meanings.example: My favourite kind of fruit is watermelon.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的水果是西瓜。

meanings.definition: Friendly, caring, and nice to others.
meanings.example: It’s kind to share your toys with others.
meanings.example_cn: 和别人分享玩具是善良的表现。

meanings.definition: A man who is the ruler of a country.
meanings.example: The king wore a golden crown and a red robe.
meanings.example_cn: 国王戴着金色的王冠，穿着红色的长袍。

meanings.definition: The joint in the middle of your leg that lets you bend it.
meanings.example: My knee got scraped when I slid on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我在操场上滑倒时擦破了膝盖。

meanings.definition: A tool with a sharp edge used for cutting things.
meanings.example: Please be careful when you use a knife to cut your food.
meanings.example_cn: 用刀切食物时要小心。

meanings.definition: To understand something.
meanings.example: I know how to tie my shoes by myself.
meanings.example_cn: 我知道怎么自己系鞋带。

meanings.definition: To be familiar with something or someone.
meanings.example: Do you know this fun game we're playing?
meanings.example_cn: 你知道我们在玩的这个游戏吗？

meanings.definition: Recognised by many people.
meanings.definition_cn: 知名的；被许多人认识的
meanings.example: The old tree is known for its big branches.
meanings.example_cn: 那棵老树以它粗大的枝干而闻名。

meanings.definition: Something that people understand or have heard about.
meanings.definition_cn: 为人们所了解或听说的
meanings.example: Polar bears are known for living in cold, snowy places.
meanings.example_cn: 北极熊以生活在寒冷多雪的地方而闻名。

meanings.definition: A special room where scientists do experiments and tests.
meanings.example: We did a cool science experiment in the lab.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在实验室里做了一个很酷的科学实验。

meanings.definition: A small, round, red insect with black spots on its back.
meanings.example: A tiny ladybug landed on my finger.
meanings.example_cn: 一只小瓢虫落在我的手指上。

meanings.definition: A large area of water surrounded by land.
meanings.example: The lake was calm and full of ducks.
meanings.example_cn: 湖面平静，满是鸭子。

meanings.definition: A young sheep.
meanings.example: The lamb followed its mother around the field.
meanings.example_cn: 小羊跟着妈妈在田野里走。

meanings.definition: The meat that comes from a young sheep.
meanings.example: We had roast lamb and potatoes for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 我们晚餐吃了烤羊肉配土豆。

meanings.definition: The part of the earth that is not covered by water.
meanings.example: We saw a boat approaching the land after a long trip.
meanings.example_cn: 长途航行后我们看见一艘船靠近陆地。

meanings.definition: A country or nation, an area with its own people and borders.
meanings.example: Japan is a land known for cherry blossoms.
meanings.example_cn: 日本以樱花闻名。

meanings.definition: To arrive on the ground after flying.
meanings.example: The airplane will land at the airport soon.

meanings.definition: Big in size or much bigger than usual.
meanings.example: The large balloon floated high above the trees.
meanings.example_cn: 那个大气球高高地飘在树的上方。

meanings.definition: Coming after all the others or being the final one.
meanings.example: I was the last person in line for ice cream.
meanings.example_cn: 我是排队买冰淇淋的最后一个人。

meanings.definition: To keep going or continue for some time.
meanings.example: I hope the batteries last until the end of the movie.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望电池能坚持到电影结束。

meanings.definition: Arriving or happening after the expected time.
meanings.example: We were late to school because of the traffic.
meanings.example_cn: 因为交通堵塞，我们上学迟到了。

meanings.definition: Happening or coming near the end of a period of time.
meanings.example: He finished his project late in the evening.
meanings.example_cn: 他晚上很晚才完成项目。

meanings.definition: To make sounds of joy, often when something is funny.
meanings.example: We laugh so much when we play silly games.
meanings.example_cn: 我们玩有趣的游戏时笑个不停。

meanings.definition: To make fun of someone or something in a mean or unkind way, not because something is funny, but to hurt their feelings.
meanings.example: It was unkind of the kids to laugh at Peter when he tripped on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们看到彼得在操场上绊倒，却嘲笑他，这很不友善。

meanings.definition: The sound or act of laughing, usually when something is funny or makes you happy.
meanings.definition_cn: 笑的声音或行为，通常是当某事有趣或令人开心时。
meanings.example: Her silly story made everyone let out a big laugh.

meanings.definition: A rule made by a government that everyone must follow.
meanings.example: There’s a law that says you must wear a helmet when riding a bike.
meanings.example_cn: 有一条法律规定，骑自行车时必须戴头盔。

meanings.definition: Not wanting to work or do anything active.
meanings.example: My cat is lazy and likes to nap all day.
meanings.example_cn: 我的猫很懒，喜欢整天打盹。

meanings.definition: To guide or show the way for others.
meanings.example: The teacher will lead us on a nature walk.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会带我们去大自然漫步。

meanings.definition: The position ahead of others, as in a race or competition
meanings.example: She took the lead in the race and finished first.
meanings.example_cn: 她在比赛中取得领先，最后拿了第一名。

meanings.definition: The flat, green part of a plant or tree that grows from a stem or branch.
meanings.example: A red leaf floated down from the tree.
meanings.example_cn: 一片红色的叶子从树上飘落下来。

meanings.definition: To jump high or far.
meanings.example: Watch the frog leap from one lily pad to another.
meanings.example_cn: 看青蛙从一片睡莲叶跳到另一片。

meanings.definition: A big jump or a sudden forward change or increase
meanings.example: The frog made a huge leap into the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 青蛙猛地一跃，跳进池塘。

meanings.definition: To go away from a place or person.
meanings.example: After the party was over, we had to leave our friend’s house and go home.
meanings.example_cn: 派对结束之后，我们不得不离开朋友家回家。

meanings.definition: To let someone or something stay in a place.
meanings.example: Please leave the cookies on the plate for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 请把饼干留在盘子里当甜点。

meanings.definition: Time when you are allowed to be away from work or duty.
meanings.definition_cn: 获准离开工作或职责的时间，休假。
meanings.example: Dad took leave from work to go on our family trip.

meanings.definition: A talk given to teach people about something.
meanings.example: The scientist gave an interesting lecture about space.
meanings.example_cn: 科学家做了一场关于太空的有趣讲座。

meanings.definition: A long, serious talk in which someone criticizes or scolds another person about what they did wrong.
meanings.example: After I forgot to do my homework, my mom gave me a lecture about being responsible.
meanings.example_cn: 我忘记写作业之后，妈妈严肃地教训我，要我要有责任心。

meanings.definition: To talk to someone for a long time, often seriously, about what they did wrong or how they should behave.
meanings.definition_cn: 长时间地、常常严肃地对某人说教，指出他们哪里做错了或该怎么做。
meanings.example: Mom lectured me about cleaning my room after I made a mess.

meanings.definition: The opposite direction of right.
meanings.example: Turn left at the stop sign to get to school.
meanings.example_cn: 在停车标志处左转就能到学校。

meanings.definition: What remains when the rest is gone.
meanings.example: There is only one piece of cake left.
meanings.example_cn: 只剩一块蛋糕了。

meanings.definition: The part of your body you use to walk and stand on.
meanings.example: She has a bandage on her leg from falling off her bike.
meanings.example_cn: 她从自行车上摔下来，腿上缠着绷带。

meanings.definition: A yellow fruit with a sour taste.
meanings.example: I made lemonade with a sour lemon and some sugar.
meanings.example_cn: 我用一个酸柠檬和一些糖做了柠檬水。

meanings.definition: A large wild cat with spots that lives in Africa and Asia.
meanings.example: The leopard has spots and runs very fast.
meanings.example_cn: 豹子身上有斑点，跑得很快。

meanings.definition: A period of time when you learn about something, often at school.
meanings.example: Today’s lesson is about how plants grow.
meanings.example_cn: 今天的课是关于植物如何生长的。

meanings.definition: Something you learn from what happens to you, especially when you make a mistake or go through something important.
meanings.example: After forgetting her umbrella and getting wet, Maya learned a lesson about always checking the weather.
meanings.example_cn: 玛雅忘了带雨伞，被雨淋湿之后，得到了一个教训：要时常查看天气情况。

meanings.definition: A written message sent to someone.
meanings.example: I got a letter from my cousin in the mail.
meanings.example_cn: 我收到表兄寄来的信。

meanings.definition: A symbol or character used in writing to stand for a sound.
meanings.example: The letter “B” comes after “A” in the alphabet.
meanings.example_cn: 字母“B”在字母表中排在“A”后面。

meanings.definition: A certain degree, stage or rank.
meanings.example: I finished the hardest level in my video game.
meanings.example_cn: 我通关了电子游戏里最难的一关。

meanings.definition: How high or low something is, a position or amount on a scale.
meanings.definition_cn: 高低；位置或数量上的水平
meanings.example: The water level in the glass was almost to the top.
meanings.example_cn: 玻璃杯里的水位几乎到了杯顶。

meanings.definition: To make something flat and even.
meanings.example: They used a tool to level the sand in the sandbox.

meanings.definition: The time when a person, animal, or plant is alive.
meanings.example: The garden is full of life with birds singing and flowers blooming.
meanings.example_cn: 鸟儿啼鸣、花儿盛放，这座花园生机勃勃。

meanings.definition: To raise something up to a higher position.
meanings.example: Can you help me lift this heavy box?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我抬起这个很重的箱子吗？

meanings.definition: A ride in a vehicle.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a lift to school this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 早上妈妈开车送我去上学。

meanings.definition: An elevator that carries people or things up and down.
meanings.definition_cn: 载人或载物上下楼的电梯。
meanings.example: We rode the lift to the top floor of the building.

meanings.definition: The energy that lets us see things.
meanings.example: Open the curtains to let in some light.
meanings.example_cn: 拉开窗帘，让一些光进来。

meanings.definition: Not heavy, easy to lift or carry.
meanings.example: This backpack is light, so I can carry it myself.
meanings.example_cn: 这个背包很轻，我自己能背。

meanings.definition: Very bright or full of light.
meanings.definition_cn: 非常明亮或充满光线的。
meanings.example: The classroom was light and sunny with all the windows open.

meanings.definition: A small green fruit that tastes sour.
meanings.example: I squeezed a lime into my cold water for a fresh taste.
meanings.example_cn: 我往凉水里挤了一颗青柠，喝起来很清爽。

meanings.definition: A long, thin mark or row.
meanings.example: Please stand in a straight line before we go outside.
meanings.example_cn: 出去之前请站成一条直线。

meanings.definition: To stand or arrange in a row or queue.
meanings.example: We all line up before going outside for recess.
meanings.example_cn: 我们出去课间活动之前都要排好队。

meanings.definition: A big wild cat with a mane, known as the king of the jungle.
meanings.example: The lion roared loudly at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 狮子在动物园里大声吼叫。

meanings.definition: A set of names or things written down one after another.
meanings.example: I made a list of things to pack for camp.
meanings.example_cn: 我列了一张野营要带的东西的清单。

meanings.definition: To write things down one after another in order.
meanings.example: Let's list the ingredients we need for the cake.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们列出做蛋糕需要的材料。

meanings.definition: Small in size or amount.
meanings.example: My little brother loves dinosaurs.
meanings.example_cn: 我的小弟弟喜欢恐龙。

meanings.definition: To be alive.
meanings.example: Some plants can live for over a hundred years.
meanings.example_cn: 有些植物能活一百多年。

meanings.definition: To have your home in a place or to stay somewhere.
meanings.example: I live in a house with my family and my dog.
meanings.example_cn: 我和家人还有狗住在一所房子里。

meanings.definition: Happening right now, not recorded earlier.
meanings.definition_cn: 正在实时发生的，不是事先录制的。
meanings.example: We watched a live concert on TV last night.

meanings.definition: A small reptile with dry, scaly skin and a long tail.
meanings.example: A tiny lizard scurried across the warm rock.
meanings.example_cn: 一只小蜥蜴迅速爬过温暖的岩石。

meanings.definition: Measuring a great distance from end to end.
meanings.example: He has a long jump rope that reaches across the room.
meanings.example_cn: 他有一根长长的跳绳，能横跨整个房间。

meanings.definition: Taking a lot of time, not quick.
meanings.example: The movie was so long that I almost fell asleep.
meanings.example_cn: 这部电影太长了，我差点睡着。

meanings.definition: To strongly wish or hope for something, especially something you really want to happen.
meanings.definition_cn: 强烈地渴望或希望某件事，尤其是非常盼望发生的事。
meanings.example: I long for summer vacation to start.

meanings.definition: To use your eyes to pay attention to something.
meanings.example: Look at the rainbow outside the window!
meanings.example_cn: 看窗外那道彩虹！

meanings.definition: To seem or appear in a certain way.
meanings.example: You look happy today with your big smile.
meanings.example_cn: 你带着大大的笑容，今天看起来很幸福。

meanings.definition: The act of looking.
meanings.example: She gave her friend a look to let him know it was his turn.

meanings.definition: Not tight, so it can move or come off easily.
meanings.example: My tooth feels loose and might fall out soon.
meanings.example_cn: 我的牙有点松，可能很快就会掉。

meanings.definition: A large amount or number of something.
meanings.example: We have a lot of books on our shelf.
meanings.example_cn: 我们书架上有很多书。

meanings.definition: A bunch of things or people all together, like a group or a batch.
meanings.example: The bakery made a new lot of cookies this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 这家面包店今早制作了一批新的曲奇饼干。

meanings.definition: Making a lot of noise and not quiet.
meanings.example: The thunder was so loud it made me jump.
meanings.example_cn: 雷声很大，吓了我一跳。

meanings.definition: Not high, so it is close to the ground.
meanings.example: The cat crawled under the low table to hide.
meanings.example_cn: 猫爬到矮桌子下面躲起来。

meanings.definition: Small in amount, level or number.
meanings.example: The water in the glass was low, so I filled it up again.
meanings.example_cn: 杯子里的水不多了，于是我又把它倒满。

meanings.definition: Feeling sad, unhappy, or without much energy.
meanings.definition_cn: 感到难过、不开心或没精打采的，情绪低落的。
meanings.example: He felt low when his pet fish got sick.

meanings.definition: Always supporting and standing by someone or something.
meanings.example: Dogs are loyal pets and always happy to see you.
meanings.example_cn: 狗是忠诚的宠物，总是很高兴见到你。

meanings.definition: Letters and packages sent to or from people.
meanings.example: I love getting mail from my cousins in another city.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢收到另一个城市的表兄妹寄来的邮件。

meanings.definition: To send something, like a letter or package, to someone using the postal service.
meanings.example: I will mail a birthday card to my grandma tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我明天要给奶奶寄一张生日贺卡。

meanings.definition: To create, build, or produce something.
meanings.example: Let's make a giant sandcastle at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们在海滩上堆一座巨大的沙堡。

meanings.definition: To cause something to happen or come to be.
meanings.example: Loud noises make my puppy bark a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 大声的噪音会让我的小狗叫个不停。

meanings.definition: An adult male person.
meanings.example: The man who lives next door always waves hello.
meanings.example_cn: 住在隔壁的那个男人总是挥手问好。

meanings.definition: A human being or person, sometimes used for all people, not just a male.
meanings.example: Long ago, man learned how to make fire.
meanings.example_cn: 很久很久以前，人类学会了生火。

meanings.definition: A drawing that shows where places are.
meanings.example: The map helped us find the hidden treasure.
meanings.example_cn: 地图帮我们找到了隐藏的宝藏。

meanings.definition: To plan or show something on a map.
meanings.example: We mapped out our route before the hike.
meanings.example_cn: 远足前我们规划好了路线。

meanings.definition: The third month of the year.
meanings.example: My birthday is in March, and I always hope for sunny weather.
meanings.example_cn: 我的生日在三月，我一直盼望能有晴朗的好天气。

meanings.definition: To walk with steady, regular steps, often as a group.
meanings.example: We will march in the school parade next week.
meanings.example_cn: 下周我们要参加学校游行，一起行进。

meanings.definition: To make a visible sign, symbol, or line on something, or to highlight something in some way.
meanings.example: Please mark your answers on the test sheet.
meanings.example_cn: 请在试卷上标出你的答案。

meanings.definition: A spot, line, or sign that shows where something is or that something happened.
meanings.example: There was a red mark on my shirt from the juice spill.

meanings.definition: A place where people buy and sell things.
meanings.example: The market was crowded with people buying fresh fruit.
meanings.example_cn: 市场里挤满了买新鲜水果的人。

meanings.definition: To promote and sell goods.
meanings.example: They market their toys online to more kids.
meanings.example_cn: 他们在网上向更多孩子推销玩具。

meanings.definition: A game or contest between two or more teams or people.
meanings.example: We watched an exciting soccer match at the stadium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在体育场看了一场激动人心的足球赛。

meanings.definition: To be the same as.
meanings.definition_cn: 与…… 相同；相一致；相配
meanings.example: She tried to match her socks so both were the same colour.
meanings.example_cn: 她试着把袜子配成一对，让两只袜子颜色相同。

meanings.definition: To go well with something else.
meanings.example: Her blue shirt matches her blue shoes.

meanings.definition: The fifth month of the year.
meanings.example: The flowers in our garden start to bloom in May.
meanings.example_cn: 我们花园里的花在五月开始绽放。

meanings.definition: Used to show that something is possible or might happen.
meanings.example: It may rain tomorrow, so bring your umbrella.
meanings.example_cn: 明天可能会下雨，带上伞吧。

meanings.definition: To be allowed to do something.
meanings.example: May I go outside and play after dinner?

meanings.definition: The word you use to talk about yourself as the object of a sentence.
meanings.example: Can you pass me the green marker?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把绿色的马克笔递给我吗？

meanings.definition: To express, show, or intend something.
meanings.example: What does the word “brave” mean?
meanings.example_cn: “brave” 这个单词是什么意思？

meanings.definition: To have a plan or purpose for something.
meanings.example: I didn’t mean to spill my juice on the table.
meanings.example_cn: 我不是故意把果汁洒在桌子上的。

meanings.definition: Not nice, treating others in an unkind way.
meanings.definition_cn: 不友善，对别人不友好的，刻薄的。
meanings.example: It was mean to leave your friend out of the game.

meanings.definition: To find out the size, length, or amount of something.
meanings.example: Let’s measure how tall you’ve grown this year.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们量量你今年长高了多少。

meanings.definition: An approach means an action, step, or method taken to achieve something or solve a problem.
meanings.example: The school took new safety measures to keep everyone healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 学校采取了新的安全措施来保障所有人的健康。

meanings.definition: The part of an animal that people eat.
meanings.example: The stew had tender meat and tasty carrots in it.
meanings.example_cn: 炖肉里有嫩肉和美味的胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: A special metal prize given for winning or doing well.
meanings.example: She won a shiny medal for running the fastest.
meanings.example_cn: 她因为跑得最快赢得了一枚闪亮的奖牌。

meanings.definition: Something you take to help you feel better when you are sick.
meanings.example: The doctor gave me medicine to help me feel better.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给了我药，帮助我好转。

meanings.definition: A large, round fruit with sweet, juicy flesh inside.
meanings.example: I ate a slice of sweet melon for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了一片甜瓜当甜点。

meanings.definition: A person who belongs to a group or club.
meanings.example: My sister is a member of the chess club.
meanings.example_cn: 我妹妹是国际象棋俱乐部的成员。

meanings.definition: The ability to remember things that happened in the past.
meanings.example: My grandma has a great memory for old stories.
meanings.example_cn: 我奶奶对老故事的记忆力很好。

meanings.definition: Something you remember from the past.
meanings.example: One special memory is building sandcastles at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 一个特别的回忆是在海滩上堆沙堡。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about something that is possible or maybe will happen.
meanings.example: We might see a rainbow after the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨后我们可能会看到彩虹。

meanings.definition: Used to make a suggestion.
meanings.example: You might want to bring a jacket if it gets cold.
meanings.example_cn: 如果变冷，你也许想带件夹克。

meanings.definition: Great power or strength.
meanings.example: The superhero used all his might to lift the heavy rock.

meanings.definition: Not strong or harsh, but gentle.
meanings.example: The soup was mild, not spicy at all.
meanings.example_cn: 汤味道很淡，一点都不辣。

meanings.definition: The white liquid that comes from cows and other animals, or from plants, that people drink.
meanings.example: I drank a glass of cold milk with my cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 我喝了一杯冷牛奶配饼干。

meanings.definition: To take milk from a cow or other animal
meanings.example: The farmer will milk the cows every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 农夫每天早上都会给奶牛挤奶。

meanings.definition: A very big number that is equal to one thousand thousand (1,000,000).
meanings.definition_cn: 一个很大的数字，等于一百万
meanings.example: If you had a million candies, you would have way more than you could ever eat!
meanings.example_cn: 如果你有一百万颗糖果，那数量远远超出你能吃完的量！

meanings.definition: A unit of time that is sixty seconds long.
meanings.example: There’s only one minute left in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛只剩一分钟了。

meanings.definition: New or using the latest ideas, style, or technology.
meanings.example: Our modern school has computers in every classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 我们现代化的学校每个教室都有电脑。

meanings.definition: A very short period of time.
meanings.example: Wait a moment while I tie my shoe.
meanings.example_cn: 等我系一下鞋带。

meanings.definition: The second day of the week.
meanings.example: Monday is the first day of the school week.
meanings.example_cn: 星期一是学校一周的第一天。

meanings.definition: Coins and notes that people use to buy things.
meanings.example: I saved my money to buy a new book.
meanings.example_cn: 我攒钱买了一本新书。

meanings.definition: An animal with a long tail that can climb and swing from trees.
meanings.example: The monkey swung from branch to branch in the tree.
meanings.example_cn: 猴子在树上从一个树枝荡到另一个树枝。

meanings.definition: About thirty days or one of the twelve parts of a year.
meanings.example: My birthday is next month, and I can’t wait!
meanings.example_cn: 我的生日在下个月，我等不及了！

meanings.definition: The round object that moves around the Earth and can be seen in the night sky.
meanings.example: The moon was full and bright last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚月亮又圆又亮。

meanings.definition: The early part of the day, before noon.
meanings.example: I have breakfast every morning before school.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天早上上学前吃早餐。

meanings.definition: A small flying insect that can bite and suck blood.
meanings.example: A mosquito buzzed around my ear at night.
meanings.example_cn: 夜里一只蚊子在耳边嗡嗡叫。

meanings.definition: A female parent, or your mum.
meanings.example: My mother makes the best chocolate chip cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 我妈妈做巧克力曲奇最好吃。

meanings.definition: A very high hill with steep sides.
meanings.example: We climbed a tall mountain on our family trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我们家庭旅行时爬了一座高山。

meanings.definition: A small animal with a long tail and whiskers.
meanings.example: A tiny mouse nibbled on a piece of cheese.
meanings.example_cn: 一只小老鼠啃着一块奶酪。

meanings.definition: A small tool that you move with your hand to control the pointer or cursor on a computer screen.
meanings.example: I used the mouse to click on my favourite game.
meanings.example_cn: 我用鼠标点击打开我最喜欢的游戏。

meanings.definition: The part of your face you use to eat, drink, and speak.
meanings.example: Please cover your mouth when you sneeze.
meanings.example_cn: 打喷嚏时请捂住嘴。

meanings.definition: To go from one place to another.
meanings.example: Please move your chair closer to the table.
meanings.example_cn: 请把椅子挪到离桌子近一点。

meanings.definition: To change where you are.
meanings.example: We will move to a new house next summer.
meanings.example_cn: 明年夏天我们要搬到新房子去。

meanings.definition: An action or step you take.
meanings.definition_cn: 你采取的行动或走的一步棋。
meanings.example: His next move in the game was very smart.

meanings.definition: Causing strong feelings or making you feel emotional.
meanings.example: The movie had a moving ending that made everyone smile and cry at the same time.
meanings.example_cn: 这部电影有感人至深的结尾，让每个人都边笑边流泪。

meanings.definition: One that moves.
meanings.example: The moving train sped past the station, making a loud whooshing sound.
meanings.example_cn: 飞驰的火车呼啸着驶过车站。

meanings.definition: Wet, soft earth.
meanings.example: I got mud on my shoes after the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨后我的鞋上沾了泥。

meanings.definition: Sounds made by singing or playing instruments, often with a tune.
meanings.example: We listened to happy music and danced in the living room.
meanings.example_cn: 我们听欢快的音乐，在客厅里跳舞。

meanings.definition: You have to do it because it is necessary.
meanings.example: You must wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
meanings.example_cn: 骑自行车时必须戴头盔。

meanings.definition: Used to say that something is probably true or almost certain.
meanings.example: That must be the new student everyone is talking about.
meanings.example_cn: 那一定是大家都在谈论的新同学。

meanings.definition: Something you must have or do, a necessity.
meanings.definition_cn: 必须有或必须做的事，必需品。
meanings.example: A warm coat is a must when it’s snowing outside.

meanings.definition: Belonging to the person speaking.
meanings.example: My little brother loves dinosaurs.
meanings.example_cn: 我的小弟弟喜欢恐龙。

meanings.definition: The word you use to talk about you as the object of a sentence when you are also the subject.
meanings.example: I taught myself how to draw cartoon animals.
meanings.example_cn: 我自学了画卡通动物。

meanings.definition: The word that people call you or something else.
meanings.example: My dog’s name is Max, and he loves to play fetch.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗叫Max，它喜欢玩接球。

meanings.definition: To choose or say what something or someone is called.
meanings.example: We decided to name our new kitten Whiskers.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定给我们的小猫取名Whiskers。

meanings.definition: Not wide, so it is thin from side to side.
meanings.example: We walked down the narrow path between the trees.
meanings.example_cn: 我们走在树间狭窄的小路上。

meanings.definition: Not far away or close by.
meanings.example: There’s a playground near our house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们家附近有一个操场。

meanings.definition: Happening soon or close to a certain time.
meanings.example: It’s near bedtime, so start getting ready.
meanings.example_cn: 快到睡觉时间了，开始准备吧。

meanings.definition: The part of your body between your head and your shoulders.
meanings.example: He wore a soft scarf around his neck in the winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天他在脖子上围了一条柔软的围巾。

meanings.definition: To require something because it is necessary.
meanings.example: You need a warm coat in winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天你需要一件暖和的外套。

meanings.definition: To have to do something because it is necessary.
meanings.example: I need to finish my homework before I can play.
meanings.example_cn: 我需要先完成作业才能玩。

meanings.definition: Something very important to have in order to live or do something.
meanings.definition_cn: 为了生存或做某事所必需的重要东西。
meanings.example: Food and water are a need for every living thing.

meanings.definition: Not one and not the other.
meanings.example: Neither of the shirts fit me, so I picked another.
meanings.example_cn: 两件衬衫我都不合身，所以我选了另一件。

meanings.definition: Feeling worried or afraid about something that might happen.
meanings.example: I felt nervous before my dance recital.
meanings.example_cn: 舞蹈演出前我很紧张。

meanings.definition: Not ever happening at any time.
meanings.example: I have never seen such a bright rainbow before.
meanings.example_cn: 我从没见过这么明亮的彩虹。

meanings.definition: Not old, so it was made, found, or discovered recently.
meanings.example: I got a new backpack for the first day of school.
meanings.example_cn: 开学第一天我买了一个新书包。

meanings.definition: Coming right after something or someone else.
meanings.example: My birthday is next week, and I can’t wait!
meanings.example_cn: 我的生日在下周，我等不及了！

meanings.definition: The time when it is dark and the sun is not in the sky.
meanings.example: The stars shine brightly at night in the countryside.
meanings.example_cn: 在乡下，夜晚的星星闪闪发光。

meanings.definition: A scary or bad dream.
meanings.example: I had a nightmare about a giant spider last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚我做了一个关于巨大蜘蛛的噩梦。

meanings.definition: A word used to say you do not want or do not agree.
meanings.definition_cn: 不；不是（表示拒绝或不同意）
meanings.example: No, you can’t have dessert until you eat your dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 不行，你吃完晚饭才能吃甜点。

meanings.definition: No person is there or not anyone.
meanings.example: Nobody wanted to play outside in the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨中没有人想在外面玩。

meanings.definition: To move your head up and down to say “yes” or to show you agree.
meanings.example: Nod your head if you agree with me.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你同意我，就点点头。

meanings.definition: A movement of the head up and down to say yes or agree
meanings.example: She gave a nod to show she agreed with the idea.
meanings.example_cn: 她点了点头，表示她赞同这个想法。

meanings.definition: Making a lot of loud sounds and not quiet.
meanings.example: The playground was noisy with kids shouting and laughing.
meanings.example_cn: 操场很吵，孩子们在喊叫大笑。

meanings.definition: Not any or not one.
meanings.example: There were none of my favourite cookies left.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的饼干一个都不剩了。

meanings.definition: A long, thin piece of food made from flour, often cooked in soup or sauce.
meanings.example: I used chopsticks to eat my noodle soup.
meanings.example_cn: 我用筷子吃面条汤。

meanings.definition: The part of your face you use to smell and breathe.
meanings.example: My nose twitches when I smell fresh bread.
meanings.example_cn: 闻到新鲜面包时，我的鼻子会抽动。

meanings.definition: Used to make a sentence negative or show the opposite meaning.
meanings.example: My shoes are not under the bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我的鞋不在床底下。

meanings.definition: A short message or a few words written to someone.
meanings.example: Please write a thank-you note to Grandma.
meanings.example_cn: 请给奶奶写一张感谢卡。

meanings.definition: To write something down so you remember it.
meanings.example: Please note your homework in your notebook so you don’t forget.
meanings.example_cn: 请把家庭作业记在笔记本上，免得忘记。

meanings.definition: To notice or remark on something.
meanings.definition_cn: 注意到某事物或就某事物发表看法。
meanings.example: Please note that the test is on Friday.

meanings.definition: Not anything at all or zero.
meanings.example: There is nothing under my bed except dust.
meanings.example_cn: 床底下除了灰尘什么都没有。

meanings.definition: The eleventh month of the year.
meanings.example: November is when the weather starts to get cold.
meanings.example_cn: 十一月是天气开始变冷的时候。

meanings.definition: Happening at this moment or right away.
meanings.example: We can start the movie now that everyone is here.
meanings.example_cn: 既然大家都到了，我们可以开始看电影了。

meanings.definition: Right at this moment or immediately.
meanings.example: Come here now or you'll miss the bus!
meanings.example_cn: 现在就过来，否则你会错过公交车！

meanings.definition: Not in any place at all.
meanings.example: We searched everywhere, but the puppy was nowhere to be found.
meanings.example_cn: 我们到处都找了，但那只小狗哪里都找不到。

meanings.definition: A word or sign that shows an amount or position in a list.
meanings.example: What number comes after twenty-nine?
meanings.example_cn: 二十九后面的数字是多少？

meanings.definition: To give a number to something.
meanings.example: The teacher asked us to number our pages from one to ten.
meanings.example_cn: 老师让我们把页码从一标到十。

meanings.definition: To count up to a total.
meanings.example: The teacher asked us to number the pages of our book.

meanings.definition: A person whose job is to care for sick or injured people.
meanings.example: The nurse put a bandage on my scraped knee.
meanings.example_cn: 护士在我擦破的膝盖上贴了绷带。

meanings.definition: To care for someone who is sick or injured
meanings.example: Mom will nurse my little brother when he is sick.
meanings.example_cn: 弟弟生病时，妈妈会照料他。

meanings.definition: A hard-shelled seed that you can eat.
meanings.example: I like to snack on almonds, which are a kind of nut.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢吃杏仁，它属于坚果类。

meanings.definition: The large, salty sea that covers much of the Earth.
meanings.example: We watched the waves crash in the ocean on vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 度假时我们看着海浪拍打海洋。

meanings.definition: The tenth month of the year.
meanings.example: October is when the leaves turn orange and red.
meanings.example_cn: 十月是树叶变成橙色和红色的时节。

meanings.definition: A sea creature with a soft body and eight arms.
meanings.example: The octopus has eight long arms and swims quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 章鱼有八条长长的触手，游得很快。

meanings.definition: Used to show belonging.
meanings.example: The wheels of my new bike are bright red.
meanings.example_cn: 我新自行车的轮子是鲜红色的。

meanings.definition: Used to show what something is made from.
meanings.example: This necklace is made of shiny gold.
meanings.example_cn: 这条项链是用闪亮的黄金做的。

meanings.definition: No longer attached to something.
meanings.example: Please take your shoes off before coming inside.
meanings.example_cn: 进屋前请把鞋脱掉。

meanings.definition: Not working or not turned on.
meanings.example: The lights are off because no one is in the room.
meanings.example_cn: 灯关着，因为房间里没有人。

meanings.definition: Away from a place or location.
meanings.example: The cat jumped off the table.

meanings.definition: A place where people work at desks, usually with computers and phones.
meanings.example: Mom works in an office downtown.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈在市中心的一间办公室工作。

meanings.definition: Happening many times or regularly.
meanings.example: We often eat pancakes for breakfast on Sundays.
meanings.example_cn: 我们经常在周日早餐吃煎饼。

meanings.definition: Having lived or existed for a long time.
meanings.example: My grandpa has an old watch from when he was a boy.
meanings.example_cn: 我爷爷有一块他小时候戴的旧手表。

meanings.definition: Touching or resting on a surface.
meanings.example: There are three apples on the kitchen table.
meanings.example_cn: 厨房桌上有三个苹果。

meanings.definition: About or connected to a subject or topic.
meanings.example: We had a lesson on dinosaurs in science class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在科学课上学了恐龙。

meanings.definition: The number 1 or a single person or thing.
meanings.example: There is only one cookie left in the jar.
meanings.example_cn: 罐子里只剩一块饼干了。

meanings.definition: A round vegetable with layers, often used in cooking.
meanings.example: I cried a little when I cut the onion for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 切洋葱做晚饭时我哭了一下。

meanings.definition: No more than what is mentioned, just this one and no others.
meanings.example: Lila only ate one cookie after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 莱拉晚饭后只吃了一块曲奇饼干。

meanings.definition: Just this one and no more.
meanings.example: She's the only person who knows the secret.
meanings.example_cn: 她是唯一知道秘密的人。

meanings.definition: Moving to a position on a surface.
meanings.example: The kitten climbed onto the soft pillow.
meanings.example_cn: 小猫爬上了柔软的枕头。

meanings.definition: Not shut or closed, so you can enter.
meanings.example: Leave the door open so the cat can come in.
meanings.example_cn: 让门开着，猫才能进来。

meanings.definition: To make something not closed so you can enter or use it.
meanings.example: Can you open the bottle for me?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我打开瓶子吗？

meanings.definition: Used to show a choice between two or more things.
meanings.example: Would you like apple juice or orange juice?
meanings.example_cn: 你想要苹果汁还是橙汁？

meanings.definition: A round, orange-coloured fruit with sweet, juicy flesh.
meanings.example: I peeled an orange and shared the sweet slices with my sister.
meanings.example_cn: 我剥了一个橙子，和妹妹分享甜甜的橙瓣。

meanings.definition: The colour between red and yellow, like the fruit.
meanings.example: He wore an orange jacket that was easy to spot in the crowd.
meanings.example_cn: 他穿着一件橙色夹克，在人群中很容易认出。

meanings.definition: To tell someone to do something.
meanings.example: I will order a cheese pizza for dinner tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚晚餐我要点一份芝士披萨。

meanings.definition: When someone tells you what to do and expects you to do it.
meanings.example: The coach gave the team an order to line up before the game started.
meanings.example_cn: 教练向全队下达指令，要求大家在比赛开始前排好队。

meanings.definition: The arrangement of things or people in a special way, like by size, number, or time.
meanings.definition_cn: 按特定方式（如大小、数量或时间）排列事物或人的顺序。
meanings.example: The teacher lined us up in order by height.

meanings.definition: A different or additional person or thing.
meanings.example: I have one red shoe and the other is blue.
meanings.example_cn: 我有一只红色的鞋，另一只是蓝色的。

meanings.definition: The second of two things or people, not this one.
meanings.example: You take one cookie, and I'll have the other.
meanings.example_cn: 你拿一块饼干，另一块我来吃。

meanings.definition: Belonging to us.
meanings.example: Our class made a colourful mural for the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班为走廊画了一幅彩色壁画。

meanings.definition: Used when the people speaking are also doing the action.
meanings.example: We made the lemonade ourselves with fresh lemons.
meanings.example_cn: 我们自己用新鲜柠檬做了柠檬水。

meanings.definition: Away from inside or not in a place anymore.
meanings.example: The dog ran out of the house to chase the squirrel.
meanings.example_cn: 狗跑出屋子去追松鼠。

meanings.definition: Away from home or not inside a place.
meanings.example: Dad is out right now but will be back soon.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸现在出去了，但很快就回来。

meanings.definition: Above or across something.
meanings.example: The aeroplane flew over the city buildings.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机飞过城市的楼宇。

meanings.definition: Something is finished or ended.
meanings.example: The game is over, and everyone played well.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束了，大家都表现得很出色。

meanings.definition: More than a certain number or amount.
meanings.example: There are over twenty kids in my class.

meanings.definition: Belonging to me, you, or someone else, not shared with others.
meanings.example: I have my own set of coloured pencils.
meanings.example_cn: 我有自己的一套彩色铅笔。

meanings.definition: To have or possess something as yours.
meanings.example: She owns a beautiful violin.
meanings.example_cn: 她拥有一把漂亮的小提琴。

meanings.definition: A box or parcel wrapped up to be sent or delivered.
meanings.example: There’s a package at the door for you.
meanings.example_cn: 门口有一个给你的包裹。

meanings.definition: To put something into a box or wrapping.
meanings.example: We will package the cookies in a box to give as a present.
meanings.example_cn: 我们要把饼干装盒，当作礼物送人。

meanings.definition: To design and present a product for sale.
meanings.definition_cn: 设计并包装产品以供销售。
meanings.example: The company will package the toys in colourful boxes.

meanings.definition: A very large, fancy house where a king, queen, or ruler lives.
meanings.example: The princess lived in a sparkling palace by the sea.
meanings.example_cn: 公主住在海边一座闪闪发光的宫殿里。

meanings.definition: Very light in colour and not bright.
meanings.example: She looked pale after staying in bed all day.
meanings.example_cn: 她在床上躺了一整天后，脸色很苍白。

meanings.definition: To become pale in the face.
meanings.example: She began to pale when she felt scared during the movie.
meanings.example_cn: 看电影的时候她感到害怕，脸色开始变得苍白。

meanings.definition: To seem less important when compared to something else.
meanings.definition_cn: 相比之下显得不那么重要，相形见绌。
meanings.example: The excitement of the new game made the old one pale in comparison.

meanings.definition: A thin, flat, round cake cooked in a pan and often eaten for breakfast.
meanings.example: I love pancakes with syrup for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢早餐吃加糖浆的煎饼。

meanings.definition: Clothes you wear on your legs, also called trousers.
meanings.example: I wore my favourite blue pants to school today.
meanings.example_cn: 我今天穿着我最喜欢的蓝色裤子去上学。

meanings.definition: Thin, flat sheets used for writing, drawing, or printing.
meanings.example: Please write your name on the top of the paper.
meanings.example_cn: 请把名字写在纸的顶部。

meanings.definition: A newspaper you read to find out news and stories.
meanings.example: Dad reads the morning paper with his coffee.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸边喝咖啡边看晨报。

meanings.definition: A test or exam you do at school.
meanings.definition_cn: 在学校参加的测验或考试，试卷。
meanings.example: We have a math paper to finish for homework tonight.

meanings.definition: A box or package wrapped up to be sent to someone.
meanings.example: A big parcel arrived at our house with a red bow on top.
meanings.example_cn: 一个大包裹送到了我们家，上面系着红色的蝴蝶结。

meanings.definition: To wrap something up into a parcel.
meanings.example: I parcelled the gift up in brown paper.
meanings.example_cn: 我用牛皮纸把礼物打包好。

meanings.definition: To say someone is forgiven for a mistake.
meanings.example: Pardon me for bumping into you in the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 抱歉，我在走廊撞到你了。

meanings.definition: To politely ask someone to repeat something.
meanings.example: When I didn’t hear what my teacher said, I raised my hand and said, “Pardon?”
meanings.example_cn: 没听清老师说的话时，我举手说：“请再说一遍？”

meanings.definition: The act of forgiving someone.
meanings.example: He asked for a pardon after accidentally stepping on her foot.

meanings.definition: A mother or father, the person who takes care of you.
meanings.example: My parent helped me with my science project last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚我爸爸帮我做了科学项目。

meanings.definition: To take care of and raise a child.
meanings.example: It takes love to parent a child well.
meanings.example_cn: 好好养育一个孩子需要爱。

meanings.definition: A public place with grass and trees where people can play and relax.
meanings.example: There are so many swings and slides at the park.
meanings.example_cn: 公园里有很多秋千和滑梯。

meanings.definition: To stop a car or other vehicle and leave it in a particular place for a while.
meanings.example: Dad found a place to park the car near the store.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸在商店附近找到了停车的地方。

meanings.definition: A piece or section of something bigger.
meanings.example: I lost one part of my favourite puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的拼图丢了一块。

meanings.definition: The role or job a person has in a play or show.
meanings.example: My friend got the main part in the school play.
meanings.example_cn: 我朋友在学校话剧中担任主角。

meanings.definition: To separate or move apart.
meanings.example: The clouds parted and the sun came out.

meanings.definition: A special event where people gather to have fun and celebrate.
meanings.example: We had a birthday party with balloons and cake.
meanings.example_cn: 我们办了一个有气球和蛋糕的生日派对。

meanings.definition: To celebrate or enjoy oneself at a party
meanings.example: We love to party with friends on birthdays.
meanings.example_cn: 我们喜欢在生日的时候和朋友们办派对玩乐。

meanings.definition: A very strong feeling about something or someone.
meanings.example: She has a passion for painting colourful pictures after school.
meanings.example_cn: 她放学后对画彩色画充满热情。

meanings.definition: Food from Italy made from wheat, such as spaghetti or macaroni.
