meanings.example: Our team won a shiny trophy at the tournament.
meanings.example_cn: 我们队在锦标赛上赢得了一座闪亮的奖杯。

meanings.definition: A large, strong vehicle used to carry heavy things.
meanings.example: The delivery truck brought boxes to the store.
meanings.example_cn: 送货车把箱子送到了商店。

meanings.definition: To make an effort to do something.
meanings.example: I will try to solve this puzzle on my own.
meanings.example_cn: 我会自己试着解开这个拼图。

meanings.definition: To test or see if something works.
meanings.example: Let’s try this new game to see if we like it.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们试试这个新游戏，看看我们喜不喜欢。

meanings.definition: An attempt to do something.
meanings.example: Give it a try and see if you like it.

meanings.definition: The third day of the week.
meanings.example: Tuesday is the day we have music class.
meanings.example_cn: 星期二是我们上音乐课的日子。

meanings.definition: In a lower place or covered by something.
meanings.example: The cat hid under the bed during the thunderstorm.
meanings.example_cn: 雷雨时猫躲到了床底下。

meanings.definition: Less than a certain number or amount.
meanings.example: Children under six years old need a car seat.
meanings.example_cn: 六岁以下的儿童需要安全座椅。

meanings.definition: Except if or if not, you use it to say that something will happen only if another thing does not happen.
meanings.example: You can’t go outside unless you wear your boots.
meanings.example_cn: 你穿上靴子才能出去。

meanings.definition: Up to the time when something happens.
meanings.example: We stayed at the park until the sun went down.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在公园一直待到太阳落山。

meanings.definition: Before a certain time.
meanings.example: Until you finish your homework, you can't play video games.
meanings.example_cn: 你做完作业之前不能玩电子游戏。

meanings.definition: Moving to a higher place or position.
meanings.example: The balloon floated up into the blue sky.
meanings.example_cn: 气球飘上了蓝天。

meanings.definition: Increasing in number, amount, or level.
meanings.example: The music got louder as we turned up the volume.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把音量调大时，音乐变得更响。

meanings.definition: Moving up and on top of something.
meanings.example: The cat jumped upon the windowsill to look outside.
meanings.example_cn: 那只猫跳到窗台上往外面看。

meanings.definition: Something happens right when something else happens.
meanings.example: Upon finishing his homework, Max went outside to play.
meanings.example_cn: 马克斯做完家庭作业之后，就出去玩了。

meanings.definition: The speaker and one or more other people as the object of a sentence.
meanings.example: Grandma baked delicious cookies for us to share.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶烤了美味的饼干给我们分享。

meanings.definition: Low land between two hills or mountains.
meanings.example: A little river flowed through the green valley.
meanings.example_cn: 一条小河穿过绿色的山谷。

meanings.definition: A plant or part of a plant used as food.
meanings.example: My favourite vegetable is sweet, crunchy carrots.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的蔬菜是甜甜的、脆脆的胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: Describes something that comes from plants and is used for food.
meanings.example: They follow a vegetable diet.
meanings.example_cn: 他们遵循以蔬菜为主的饮食。

meanings.definition: To a high degree, extremely.
meanings.example: That movie was very funny and made me laugh a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 那部电影非常有趣，让我笑个不停。

meanings.definition: What you see from a certain place.
meanings.example: The view from the mountain was amazing.
meanings.example_cn: 从山上看去的景色太美了。

meanings.definition: To look at or see something.
meanings.example: They viewed the house.
meanings.example_cn: 他们看了那栋房子。

meanings.definition: What you think or believe about something, your opinion.
meanings.definition_cn: 你对某事的想法或看法，观点。
meanings.example: My view is that reading is the best hobby.

meanings.definition: A small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.
meanings.example: The village festival was full of music and laughter.
meanings.example_cn: 村庄的节日充满了音乐和欢笑。

meanings.definition: A crisp, patterned cake made from batter and cooked in a special iron.
meanings.example: We had waffles with strawberries for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早餐吃了带草莓的华夫饼。

meanings.definition: To speak or write in a way that is unclear or goes on too long.
meanings.example: Stop waffling and give a straight answer.
meanings.example_cn: 别吞吞吐吐了，直接给出答案。

meanings.definition: To move forward by putting one foot in front of the other.
meanings.example: Let's walk to the library after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们走去图书馆。

meanings.definition: A journey you take by moving forward on your feet.
meanings.example: We took a long walk through the forest to look for birds.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在森林里走了很长一段路去找鸟。

meanings.definition: The side part of a room or building that divides areas and holds up the roof.
meanings.example: We hung a colourful painting on the living room wall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把一幅彩色的画挂在客厅的墙上。

meanings.definition: To block or enclose an area by building a wall.
meanings.example: They walled off the garden to keep the dog safe.
meanings.example_cn: 他们筑墙把花园围起来，好让小狗安全。

meanings.definition: Fighting between countries or groups.
meanings.example: The history book showed pictures of soldiers during the war.
meanings.example_cn: 历史书展示了战争期间士兵的照片。

meanings.definition: To fight in a battle or conflict.
meanings.example: The two kingdoms decided to war over the land between them.
meanings.example_cn: 两个王国决定为它们之间的土地开战。

meanings.definition: A little hot, but not too hot.
meanings.example: The blanket kept me warm on the chilly night.
meanings.example_cn: 那条毯子在寒冷的夜晚让我保持温暖。

meanings.definition: To make or become warm or warmer
meanings.example: I warm my hands by the heater in winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天我在取暖器旁边暖手。

meanings.definition: To tell someone about possible danger or trouble.
meanings.example: The lifeguard used a whistle to warn swimmers about deep water.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员用哨子警告游泳者水深危险。

meanings.definition: To look at something closely for a period of time.
meanings.example: Let's watch the fireworks from the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 让我们在后院看烟花。

meanings.definition: To guard or look after something to keep it safe.
meanings.example: The lifeguard will watch the pool to keep everyone safe.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员会看守游泳池，确保大家安全。

meanings.definition: A small clock you wear on your wrist to tell time.
meanings.definition_cn: 戴在手腕上看时间的小钟，手表。
meanings.example: I wear my watch to school so I know when lunch starts.

meanings.definition: The clear liquid that all plants and animals need to live.
meanings.example: Don't forget to drink water after playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完后别忘了喝水。

meanings.definition: A sea or lake, or a big area covered with water.
meanings.example: We sailed across the blue water to the island.
meanings.example_cn: 我们划过蓝色的水域前往那座岛。

meanings.definition: To pour water on plants so they can grow or stay healthy.
meanings.definition_cn: 往植物上浇水，让它们生长或保持健康。
meanings.example: Please water the plants so they don’t get too dry.

meanings.definition: Water that falls from a high place into a pool or river below.
meanings.example: We saw a beautiful waterfall on our hike.
meanings.example_cn: 我们徒步时看到了一道美丽的瀑布。

meanings.definition: A large, round fruit with green skin and red, juicy inside.
meanings.example: Cold watermelon is the best snack on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 天热时冰镇西瓜是最好的零食。

meanings.definition: Moving water on the sea.
meanings.example: A giant wave splashed over our feet at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 海滩上一个巨浪溅湿了我们的脚。

meanings.definition: To move your hand back and forth as a greeting or signal.
meanings.example: I like to wave at my friends when I see them across the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我在操场对面看到朋友时喜欢向他们挥手。

meanings.definition: A path or a direction you can go to get somewhere.
meanings.example: There is a shortcut way to the playground through the park.
meanings.example_cn: 有一条穿过公园去操场的捷径。

meanings.definition: A method or manner of doing something.
meanings.example: The best way to solve the puzzle is to start with the corners.
meanings.example_cn: 解这道谜题的最好方法是从角落开始。

meanings.definition: The person speaking and at least one other person.
meanings.example: We made chocolate chip cookies together last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚我们一起做了巧克力曲奇。

meanings.definition: Not strong, gets tired or hurt easily.
meanings.example: I felt weak after being sick, but soon got stronger.
meanings.example_cn: 生病后我感觉很虚弱，但很快又强壮起来。

meanings.definition: The condition of the air outside at a certain time (rain, sun, wind, etc.).
meanings.example: The weather today is sunny and perfect for a picnic.
meanings.example_cn: 今天天气晴朗，很适合野餐。

meanings.definition: To survive or get through something difficult.
meanings.example: The old barn has weathered many storms and still stands strong.
meanings.example_cn: 那座旧谷仓经受住了许多暴风雨，仍然屹立不倒。

meanings.definition: The fourth day of the week.
meanings.example: Wednesday is the middle of the school week.
meanings.example_cn: 星期三是学校一周的中间。

meanings.definition: Seven days in a row.
meanings.example: We have a spelling test at the end of the week.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每周末尾有拼写测试。

meanings.definition: To greet someone in a friendly way.
meanings.example: We welcome new students and show them where everything is.
meanings.example_cn: 我们欢迎新同学，并告诉他们所有东西在哪里。

meanings.definition: A greeting to show someone is gladly received.
meanings.example: The teacher gave us a warm welcome on the first day of school.
meanings.example_cn: 开学第一天老师给了我们热烈的欢迎。

meanings.definition: Happily accepted or received by others.
meanings.definition_cn: 被他人高兴地接纳或欢迎的。
meanings.example: New students are always welcome in our class.

meanings.definition: Covered with water or liquid, not dry.
meanings.example: My socks got wet when I stepped in a big puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 我踩进一个大水坑时袜子湿了。

meanings.definition: To make something covered with water.
meanings.example: Don’t wet your shoes by running through the sprinklers!
meanings.example_cn: 别跑过喷水器弄湿你的鞋！

meanings.definition: A word used to ask for information about something.
meanings.example: What time does the movie start tonight?
meanings.example_cn: 今晚电影几点开始？

meanings.definition: The thing or idea being talked about.
meanings.example: I didn't hear what you said because it was noisy.
meanings.example_cn: 因为太吵，我没听见你说的话。

meanings.definition: Anything or everything, no matter what.
meanings.example: You can draw whatever you like in your notebook.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以在笔记本上画任何你喜欢的东西。

meanings.definition: No matter which thing or things.
meanings.example: Whatever choice you make, I’ll still be proud of you.
meanings.example_cn: 无论你做出什么选择，我都为你感到骄傲。

meanings.definition: Used to ask or talk about the time something happens.
meanings.example: When will you come over to play?
meanings.example_cn: 你什么时候过来玩？

meanings.definition: At the time something happens.
meanings.example: Call me when you get home from school.
meanings.example_cn: 你放学回到家时给我打电话。

meanings.definition: At any time, or every time something happens.
meanings.example: You can call me whenever you need help.
meanings.example_cn: 你需要帮助时可以随时给我打电话。

meanings.definition: At, in, or to what place.
meanings.example: Where did you put my favourite hat?
meanings.example_cn: 你把我最喜欢的帽子放哪儿了？

meanings.definition: The place something happens or is.
meanings.example: This is the field where we play soccer after school.
meanings.example_cn: 这是放学后我们踢足球的场地。

meanings.definition: In or to any place at all.
meanings.example: I take my favourite book wherever I go.
meanings.example_cn: 我去哪里都带着我最喜欢的书。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about a choice between two or more things.
meanings.example: I’m not sure whether to wear boots or sneakers today.
meanings.example_cn: 我不确定今天该穿靴子还是运动鞋。

meanings.definition: Used to ask someone to choose from a group.
meanings.example: Which colour do you like best, blue or green?
meanings.example_cn: 你最喜欢哪种颜色，蓝色还是绿色？

meanings.definition: Used to show which one you mean.
meanings.example: Pick the book which has the shiny cover.
meanings.example_cn: 挑那本有闪亮封面的书。

meanings.definition: During the time that something else is happening.
meanings.example: We played games while we waited for the pizza.
meanings.example_cn: 等披萨时我们玩游戏。

meanings.definition: Used to show that two things are different or opposite, like but or even though.
meanings.example: While it’s raining, we can still have fun inside.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨时，我们还是可以在室内玩。

meanings.definition: To speak very softly and quietly.
meanings.example: Please whisper in the library so we don't disturb others.
meanings.example_cn: 请小声说话，免得打扰别人。

meanings.definition: A very quiet way of talking so only someone close can hear you.
meanings.example: She told her secret in a whisper so no one else could hear.

meanings.definition: The colour of milk or snow.
meanings.example: The white cat slept on the sunny windowsill.
meanings.example_cn: 那只白猫睡在阳光充足的窗台上。

meanings.definition: Having a pale face because you are not well, or you are feeling shocked.
meanings.example: She looked white after hearing the scary news.

meanings.definition: A word you use to ask about a person.
meanings.example: Who wants to help me bake cookies?
meanings.example_cn: 谁想帮我烤饼干？

meanings.definition: The person that is being talked about.
meanings.example: She's the girl who won the spelling contest.
meanings.example_cn: 她就是那个赢得拼字比赛的女孩。

meanings.definition: A word you use to talk about the person who gets something or has something done to them.
meanings.example: To whom should I give this letter?
meanings.example_cn: 我该把这封信给谁？

meanings.definition: Used to ask or talk about who owns something.
meanings.example: Whose backpack is on the playground bench?
meanings.example_cn: 操场长椅上的背包是谁的？

meanings.definition: Having a lot of space from one side to the other, broad.
meanings.example: The river is too wide to jump across.
meanings.example_cn: 这条河太宽了，跳不过去。

meanings.definition: Shows what someone plans to do in the future.
meanings.example: Mom will pick us up after school today.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈今天放学后来接我们。

meanings.definition: Shows that someone is willing to do something.
meanings.example: I will help you carry your backpack if you need.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你需要，我会帮你背书包。

meanings.definition: The power of the mind to decide or choose.
meanings.definition_cn: 内心做出决定或选择的意志力。
meanings.example: It takes a lot of will to finish a hard puzzle.

meanings.definition: Air moving quickly, often making things blow.
meanings.example: The wind blew the leaves all around the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 风把院子里的树叶吹得到处都是。

meanings.definition: To turn or twist something around and around, usually to make it work or to wrap something up.
meanings.example: Dad showed me how to wind my watch so it would keep ticking.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸教我怎么给手表上发条，让它可以一直走。

meanings.definition: The glass part of a wall that lets light in and lets you see outside.
meanings.example: I looked out the window and saw a rainbow.
meanings.example_cn: 我朝窗外看去，看到了一道彩虹。

meanings.definition: The person who comes first in a contest or game.
meanings.example: The winner of the spelling bee got a gold medal.
meanings.example_cn: 拼字比赛的获胜者得到了一枚金牌。

meanings.definition: The coldest season of the year.
meanings.example: We build snowmen and drink hot cocoa in winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天我们堆雪人、喝热可可。

meanings.definition: To hope for something you want to happen.
meanings.example: I wish I could fly like a bird and see the world from above.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望我能像鸟一样飞翔，从高处看世界。

meanings.definition: A strong desire for something to happen.
meanings.example: Her birthday wish was for a new puppy to play with.
meanings.example_cn: 她的生日愿望是得到一只新小狗一起玩。

meanings.definition: Together or in the company of someone or something.
meanings.example: I went to the park with my cousin yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天我和表姐一起去了公园。

meanings.definition: Using something to help you do a job.
meanings.example: She cut the paper with a pair of sharp scissors.
meanings.example_cn: 她用一把锋利的剪刀剪纸。

meanings.definition: Not having something.
meanings.example: I can't finish my drawing without a green marker.
meanings.example_cn: 没有绿色的马克笔，我画不完这幅画。

meanings.definition: Not using something.
meanings.example: He finished his homework without using a calculator.
meanings.example_cn: 他没用计算器就做完了家庭作业。

meanings.definition: An adult female person.
meanings.example: The woman at the bakery gave us free samples.
meanings.example_cn: 面包店的女士给了我们免费试吃。

meanings.definition: A unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.
meanings.example: Can you spell the word “elephant” correctly?
meanings.example_cn: 你能正确拼写“大象”这个词吗？

meanings.definition: To express something in particular words or phrasing
meanings.example: Please word your answer carefully so everyone understands.
meanings.example_cn: 请仔细斟酌你的回答，让大家都能看懂。

meanings.definition: The things people do to earn money or help others, like being a teacher, doctor, or builder.
meanings.definition_cn: 工作（人们挣钱或助人的事）
meanings.example: My mom’s job is to teach children at a school.
meanings.example_cn: 我妈妈的工作是在一所学校教孩子们。

meanings.definition: To do a job or put in effort.
meanings.example: Dad will work late at the office tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸今晚会在办公室加班。

meanings.definition: The earth and all the people, places, and things on it.
meanings.example: There are many amazing animals in the world.
meanings.example_cn: 世界上有许多奇妙的动物。

meanings.definition: A long, thin animal with no legs that lives in soil.
meanings.example: We found a wriggly worm in the garden when we dug for potatoes.
meanings.example_cn: 我们挖土豆时在花园里发现了一条扭动的蚯蚓。

meanings.definition: To move slowly and smoothly, like a worm.
meanings.example: The baby tried to worm his way out of his blanket.
meanings.example_cn: 宝宝试图从他的毯子里扭出来。

meanings.definition: Feeling anxious or nervous about something.
meanings.example: I was worried when my cat didn’t come home.
meanings.example_cn: 我的猫没回家时我很担心。

meanings.definition: To make a polite request.
meanings.example: Would you please pass me the salt?
meanings.example_cn: 请你把盐递给我好吗？

meanings.definition: Used to talk about what might happen in a certain situation.
meanings.example: If I had wings, I would fly around the world.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我有翅膀，我会飞遍全世界。

meanings.definition: To make words or letters on paper or a screen.
meanings.example: Please write your name neatly on the paper.
meanings.example_cn: 请在纸上工整地写下你的名字。

meanings.definition: Twelve months or 365 days, the time it takes for Earth to go around the sun.
meanings.example: We went camping last year during the summer.
meanings.example_cn: 去年夏天我们去野营了。

meanings.definition: To shout very loudly.
meanings.example: Please don’t yell in the library; use your quiet voice.
meanings.example_cn: 请不要在图书馆大声喊叫，用你安静的声音。

meanings.definition: A loud shout or cry, usually when you are excited, scared, or want to get attention.
meanings.example: A loud yell from the playground made everyone look outside.
meanings.example_cn: 操场上一声响亮的喊叫让大家都朝外看。

meanings.definition: The colour of the sun or a banana.
meanings.example: The yellow flowers in the garden look like tiny suns.
meanings.example_cn: 花园里的黄花看起来像小太阳。

meanings.definition: The day before today.
meanings.example: Yesterday we made cookies and played board games.
meanings.example_cn: 昨天我们做了饼干、玩了桌游。

meanings.definition: Something hasn’t happened so far, but it might happen soon
meanings.definition_cn: 还；尚未（但可能马上发生）
meanings.example: I haven’t finished my homework yet, but I’m almost done.
meanings.example_cn: 我还没完成作业，但快做完了。

meanings.definition: Used to show contrast, like saying "however" or "still".
meanings.example: It was raining, yet we decided to go hiking anyway.
meanings.example_cn: 当时正在下雨，但我们还是决定去徒步。

meanings.definition: The person or people someone is talking to.
meanings.example: You did a fantastic job on your project!
meanings.example_cn: 你的项目做得太棒了！

meanings.definition: Not old, at the beginning part of life.
meanings.example: In my young days, I learned to ride a bike with my dad.
meanings.example_cn: 在我年轻的时候，我跟着爸爸学会了骑自行车。

meanings.definition: Belonging to the person you are talking to.
meanings.example: Don’t forget your warm jacket before going out.
meanings.example_cn: 出门前别忘了你的保暖夹克。

meanings.definition: Used to talk about you when you do something to or for yourself.
meanings.example: Make sure you take care of yourself if you feel sick.
meanings.example_cn: 如果感觉不舒服，一定要照顾好自己。

meanings.definition: A place where people can see many kinds of animals kept and cared for.
meanings.example: I saw a tall giraffe and a funny monkey at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我在动物园看到了高大的长颈鹿和好玩的猴子。
